newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Britain repeats objection to QMV.
newsitem.headline: Britain repeats objection to QMV.

text.p: Britain has answered a European Union request to say where it is willing to compromise on Qualified Majority Voting by reiterating that it won't.
A senior British diplomat said on Thursday that London had sent a letter to the Irish EU presidency underlining its objections to any further move towards QMV.
"Our position is quite clear," the diplomat said.

Ireland, which is currently chairing the inter-governmental conference (IGC), asked EU countries a week ago to fill out a form saying under what circumstances they would be willing to give up unanimity for QMV or a new super QMV.
Britain has said in a White Paper on the IGC it wants no further moves in that direction.
Rather that complete the questionnaire, the diplomat said Britain had simply referred the Irish to the White Paper.
The diplomat said he did not know how many other countries had filled out the Irish form, but that some had initially seemed reluctant.
"There has been quite a lot of sucking of teeth," he said.
